instruction: I'd like Mux to ask Glitch, out loud and to him directly, whether the last cell held up.

target.reason: The end state that fits is Mux having said something directly to Glitch out loud, which is speech.say-to. Mux starts in the back-room while Glitch is in the chrome-cassette, so Mux must depart west into the chrome-cassette before speaking to him; whispering would not be out loud, and plain say is not addressed to him directly.
